description: A long muted blue wool Sturgian gown over a cream linen shift, with a low square neckline and naturally fitted opaque bodice. Gold geometric woven bands frame the neckline, run down the front and edge the waist, elbow sleeves and hem. Two round bronze-gold brooches secure the upper straps. A heavy grey wool shoulder wrap with fringed edges rests along the arms. A modest front walking opening reveals the linen underlayer and dark brown shoes.
